abhilfe.erklaerung: You challenged a decision and the authority agrees with you in full or in part. It changes its original decision accordingly.

ablehnung.erklaerung: The authority decides that you will not receive all or part of what you applied for.

ablehnungsbescheid.erklaerung: This is the notice telling you that your application has been rejected in full or in part.

akte.erklaerung: In your file, the authority collects documents and information that belong to your application or proceedings.

akteneinsicht.erklaerung: Under certain conditions you may look at the documents the authority has collected on your proceedings.

aktenvermerk.erklaerung: Someone at the authority records in writing what happened or was discussed, for example a phone call or an internal assessment.

aktenzeichen.erklaerung: This is the number or reference under which the authority handles your case.

aenderung.erklaerung: Something in an earlier decision is changed.

aenderungsbescheid.erklaerung: With this notice, the authority changes an earlier decision.

amtsermittlung.erklaerung: The authority has to find out for itself what happened. It may not expect you to gather all the information and evidence on your own.

anhoerung.erklaerung: Before the authority makes a decision that may be to your disadvantage, you are often given the chance to say something about it first.

anhoerungsschreiben.erklaerung: The authority tells you what it may decide and gives you the opportunity to comment beforehand.

antrag.erklaerung: You officially ask an authority to decide on a particular benefit, support or other matter.

antragsdatum.erklaerung: This is the day you submitted your application. This date can matter later on.

antragseingang.erklaerung: This is the point in time when your application arrived at the authority.

antragsunterlagen.erklaerung: These are the forms, proofs and other documents that belong to your application.

anspruch.erklaerung: If all legal requirements are met, you may be entitled to a particular benefit or right.

aufhebung.erklaerung: An earlier decision of the authority is ended or changed in full or in part.

aufhebungsbescheid.erklaerung: In this notice, the authority tells you that an earlier decision is being revoked in full or in part.

auflage.erklaerung: The authority allows or grants something, but at the same time requires you to meet a particular requirement.

aufforderung.erklaerung: The authority wants you to do something, for example submit documents or answer a question.

auskunft.erklaerung: An authority gives you information or asks you to provide certain information.

auskunftsersuchen.erklaerung: The authority asks you or another body to provide certain information.

bearbeitung.erklaerung: The authority examines your application, your documents or your request.

bearbeitungsstand.erklaerung: This means how far the authority has got with your application or proceedings.

bedarf.erklaerung: This describes what help or support you need.

befristung.erklaerung: A decision or approval is only valid until a certain date.

beguenstigend.erklaerung: A decision gives you an advantage, for example because a benefit is granted.

bekanntgabe.erklaerung: This means when an official decision was formally communicated to you. This can matter for deadlines.

belastend.erklaerung: A decision is to your disadvantage, for example because a benefit is refused, reduced or reclaimed.

berechnung.erklaerung: The authority explains how it calculated a certain amount or benefit.

bescheid.erklaerung: An official notice is a formal decision by an authority on your specific case.

bescheidbegruendung.erklaerung: This is where the authority explains why it decided the way it did.

bestandskraft-bestandskraeftig.erklaerung: The normal way of challenging the decision is usually over. The decision therefore continues to apply for the time being.

bestimmtheit.erklaerung: A notice must make it sufficiently clear what exactly has been decided.

beteiligte.erklaerung: These are the people or bodies officially involved in proceedings.

bevollmaechtigte-person.erklaerung: You can authorise another person to deal with certain matters with the authority on your behalf.

begruendung.erklaerung: This is where the authority explains why it made a particular decision.

beweismittel.erklaerung: This is information or documents that can help show what happened or what your situation is.

bewilligung.erklaerung: The authority has granted your application in full or in part.

bewilligungsbescheid.erklaerung: This notice states that a benefit you applied for is granted to you in full or in part.

bewilligungszeitraum.erklaerung: This is the period for which a benefit has been granted to you.

dauerwirkung.erklaerung: A decision does not have effect just once but continues over a longer period, for example an ongoing approval.

datenschutz.erklaerung: Authorities may not use or pass on personal data as they please. There are legal rules for how your data is handled.

dienstweg.erklaerung: This means the intended route by which a matter is passed on or dealt with within an authority.

eingang.erklaerung: This means when your application, your letter or your documents arrived at the authority.

eingangsbestaetigung.erklaerung: With this, the authority confirms that your application, objection or documents have arrived.

einzelfall.erklaerung: Your personal situation has to be considered. Not every case can automatically be treated exactly like another one.

entscheidung.erklaerung: The authority determines how it decides on your application or another matter.

entscheidung-nach-aktenlage.begriff: Decision on the basis of the file (Entscheidung nach Aktenlage)
entscheidung-nach-aktenlage.erklaerung: The authority decides using the information and documents it has at that point.

entscheidungserheblich.erklaerung: Something matters for how the authority decides.

entziehung.erklaerung: A benefit you have been receiving is taken away from you in full or in part for the future.

ermessen.erklaerung: The law leaves the authority several options. It has to examine which decision is appropriate in your specific case.

ermessensentscheidung.erklaerung: The authority has some leeway in its decision and has to take your specific situation into account.

erforderlich.erklaerung: The authority considers something to be necessary.

erstattung.erklaerung: Money is paid back or reclaimed. What exactly is meant depends on the context.

erstattungsbescheid.erklaerung: With this notice, the authority reclaims money that has already been paid.

festsetzung.erklaerung: The authority sets something in a binding way, for example an amount.

festsetzungsbescheid.erklaerung: With this notice, a particular amount or another decision is set in a binding way.

feststellung.erklaerung: The authority officially decides that something applies or is recognised in your case.

feststellungsbescheid.erklaerung: In this notice, the authority officially establishes something, for example a particular status or requirement.

formlos.erklaerung: No particular form is mandatory. In some cases a simple written statement may be enough.

formloser-antrag.erklaerung: Depending on the benefit, it may be possible to make clear with a simple letter, for the time being, that you want to apply for something.

frist.erklaerung: By a certain date you should or must do, submit or answer something.

fristsetzung.erklaerung: The authority tells you a date by which it expects something from you.

fristverlaengerung.erklaerung: If the authority itself has set you a deadline and you need more time, you can ask for the deadline to be extended.

heilung-eines-fehlers.erklaerung: A mistake in how proceedings were conducted can, under certain conditions, still be corrected later.

hinweis.erklaerung: The authority draws your attention to something. A note is not automatically a binding decision.

kenntnisnahme.erklaerung: You are supposed to read or take note of a piece of information. That does not automatically mean you agree with it.

kuerzung.erklaerung: A benefit you receive or have applied for is set at a lower amount.

mitteilung.erklaerung: The authority informs you about something, or you inform the authority about a change.

mitteilungspflicht.erklaerung: You have to tell the responsible body about certain changes if they may matter for your benefit or your proceedings.

mitwirkung.erklaerung: You have to help with your proceedings on certain points, for example by answering questions or submitting documents you have.

mitwirkungsaufforderung.erklaerung: The authority asks you to submit certain information or documents or to do something else.

mitwirkungspflicht.erklaerung: The law can require you to take part in certain things so that the authority can decide. But that does not automatically mean you have to obtain everything yourself or meet every demand.

nach-aktenlage.begriff: On the basis of the file (Nach Aktenlage)
nach-aktenlage.erklaerung: The authority relies on the information and documents that are already in your file.

nachforderung.erklaerung: The authority wants further documents or information from you.

nachreichen.erklaerung: You hand in documents or information at a later date.

nachweis.erklaerung: Proof is meant to show that a statement is true.

nebenbestimmung.erklaerung: A decision or approval comes with additional rules, conditions or requirements.

nichtigkeit.erklaerung: In rare cases, an official decision can be so seriously flawed that it has no legal effect from the outset.

offenbare-unrichtigkeit.erklaerung: A notice contains an obvious mistake, for example a typing or calculation error.

rechtsbehelf.erklaerung: This is how you can challenge an official decision. An objection, for example, is a legal remedy.

rechtsbehelfsbelehrung.erklaerung: This states what you can do about a decision, where you have to go and how long you have to do so.

rechtsgrundlage.erklaerung: This is the law or regulation on which the authority bases its decision.

rechtswidrig.erklaerung: A decision or action does not comply with the legal rules.

rueckforderung.erklaerung: The authority wants back money that has already been paid to you.

rueckforderungsbescheid.erklaerung: With this notice, the authority reclaims a specific amount from you.

ruecknahme.erklaerung: An earlier decision is cancelled again under certain conditions.

ruecknahmebescheid.erklaerung: With this, the authority tells you that an earlier decision is being withdrawn.

sachbearbeiter-sachbearbeiterin.erklaerung: This is the person at the authority who deals with your application or proceedings.

sachstand.erklaerung: This means where your application or proceedings currently stand and what has happened so far.

sachstandsanfrage.erklaerung: You ask the authority how far your application, objection or other proceedings have got.

schriftform.erklaerung: Something has to be declared or recorded in writing. Which exact form is required depends on the particular proceedings.

stellungnahme.erklaerung: You get the chance to explain your view or respond to certain statements, documents or questions.

teilbewilligung.erklaerung: The authority grants your application only in part. So you receive part of what you applied for.

ueberzahlung.erklaerung: The authority believes that more money was paid to you than you were, in its view, entitled to.

ueberpruefungsantrag.erklaerung: With this, you ask the authority to check an older decision again, even though the normal deadline for an objection may already have passed.

umdeutung.erklaerung: Under certain conditions, a flawed decision can be treated in law as a different decision.

unterlagen-nachreichen.erklaerung: You hand in documents later that were not yet available with your first letter.

unterschrift.erklaerung: With your signature you confirm, for many letters, that the statement comes from you.

unzustaendigkeit.erklaerung: The body believes it is not responsible for your matter.

verwaltungsakt.erklaerung: This is a binding decision by an authority in your specific case. Many notices are such decisions.

verfahren.erklaerung: This means the whole process – for example from the application through the examination to the decision.

verfahrensfehler.erklaerung: A prescribed rule was not followed in the course of the proceedings.

verrechnung.erklaerung: Money you are owed is offset against a claim that a body has against you.

versagung.erklaerung: A benefit is not granted, for example because the authority believes that necessary cooperation did not take place.

versagungsbescheid.erklaerung: With this notice, the authority tells you that a benefit is not granted because of a lack of cooperation.

vollmacht.erklaerung: You allow another person to represent you before an authority in certain matters.

vollziehung.erklaerung: An official decision is put into practice.

vorbehalt.erklaerung: The authority makes clear that a decision can be checked again or changed later.

vorlaeufige-bewilligung.erklaerung: The authority initially grants a benefit only provisionally. Later it can examine it again and make a final decision.

vorsprache.erklaerung: This means that you appear in person at an authority or attend an appointment there.

widerruf.erklaerung: A decision that was originally lawful can be cancelled again under certain conditions.

widerrufsbescheid.begriff: Notice of revocation of a lawful decision (Widerrufsbescheid)
widerrufsbescheid.erklaerung: The authority tells you that an earlier decision is being revoked.

widerrufsvorbehalt.erklaerung: A notice states from the outset that the authority reserves the right to revoke it later under certain conditions.

widerspruch.erklaerung: If you do not agree with a notice, you can ask the authority to review its decision again.

widerspruchsfrist.erklaerung: This is the time you have to lodge an objection against a notice.

widerspruchsbescheid.erklaerung: This is the decision on whether, after your objection, the authority sticks to its original decision or changes it.

wirksamkeit.erklaerung: This means from when an official decision applies in law.

zahlungsaufforderung.erklaerung: The authority asks you to pay a certain amount.

zahlungsfrist.erklaerung: A demanded amount is to be paid by this date.

zusicherung.erklaerung: An authority gives you a binding commitment to make a certain decision later or to do something specific, if the legal requirements for it are met.

zustaendigkeit.erklaerung: This means which authority or body is responsible for your matter.

zustaendigkeitspruefung.erklaerung: The authority checks whether it is itself responsible for your matter, or another body.

zustellung.erklaerung: An important letter or decision is officially delivered to you. How and when this happens can matter for deadlines.

zurueckweisung.erklaerung: The authority concludes that your request, application or objection will not be granted.

zwischenbescheid.erklaerung: The authority tells you that your matter has not yet been fully dealt with and informs you of the current status.

behinderung.erklaerung: Under SGB IX, people may be considered disabled if physical, mental, intellectual or sensory impairments, in interaction with barriers, are likely to restrict their equal participation in society for more than six months.

beratung.erklaerung: Social benefit providers have advisory duties within their area of responsibility. Which advice must be offered depends on the social benefit system concerned.

besondere-leistungen-im-einzelfall.begriff: Special benefits in individual cases (Besondere Leistungen im Einzelfall)
besondere-leistungen-im-einzelfall.erklaerung: A group of benefits under social compensation law. Whether and which benefits are possible in a given case depends on the legal requirements of SGB XIV.

dienstleistung.erklaerung: Social benefits can be provided as services, benefits in kind or cash benefits. Services also include, for example, personal help and advice.

eingliederungshilfe.erklaerung: Benefits for certain people with disabilities that are meant to enable or promote a self-determined life and full, effective and equal participation in society.

eingliederungshilfetraeger.erklaerung: The body responsible for integration assistance benefits. Which authority or provider is responsible depends on the law of the federal state.

entlastungsbetrag.erklaerung: A long-term care insurance benefit for support services in everyday life provided for by law. Requirements and possible uses are set out in SGB XI.

ergaenzende-unabhaengige-teilhabeberatun.begriff: Supplementary independent participation counselling – EUTB (Ergänzende unabhängige Teilhabeberatung)
ergaenzende-unabhaengige-teilhabeberatun.erklaerung: Counselling on rehabilitation and participation for people with disabilities and people at risk of disability, independent of benefit providers and service providers. It can be used before applying for specific benefits.

erwerbsfaehigkeit.erklaerung: A social law term for whether, and to what extent, a person can work under the relevant legal requirements. Its exact meaning depends on the benefit system concerned.

erwerbsminderung.erklaerung: A legal term used mainly in the statutory pension insurance. Whether there is partial or full reduced earning capacity depends on the legal requirements and is determined by the responsible pension insurance provider.

fallmanagement.erklaerung: Under social compensation law, eligible persons can be accompanied through the application and benefit procedure by a case manager who activates and coordinates.

feststellungsverfahren.erklaerung: A procedure in which an authority determines with binding effect whether certain legal requirements are met, for example a degree of disability.

gdb-grad-der-behinderung.begriff: Degree of disability – GdB (Grad der Behinderung)
gdb-grad-der-behinderung.erklaerung: The GdB describes the effects of health impairments on participation in society. It is set in steps of ten. A particular GdB does not automatically say anything about need for long-term care or earning capacity.

gds-grad-der-schaedigungsfolgen.begriff: Degree of damage consequences – GdS (Grad der Schädigungsfolgen)
gds-grad-der-schaedigungsfolgen.erklaerung: The GdS is used in social compensation law. It describes the effects of the recognised consequences of damage on all areas of life and is set in steps of ten.

geldleistung.erklaerung: A social benefit paid out as a sum of money, for example care allowance. Which requirements apply depends on the benefit.

gesamtplan.erklaerung: In integration assistance an overall plan is drawn up. It is used to document, steer and review the individual participation process, the necessary benefits and their goals.

gesamtplankonferenz.erklaerung: In the overall plan procedure, the benefits needed can be discussed and agreed together with the person entitled to benefits and the bodies involved.

gesamtplanverfahren.erklaerung: The integration assistance procedure for assessing and planning individual support needs. The person entitled to benefits must be involved in each step.

gleichstellung.erklaerung: People with a GdB of at least 30 but less than 50 can, under certain conditions, be given equal status with severely disabled people in working life.

grundsicherung-im-alter-und-bei-erwerbsm.begriff: Basic income support in old age and in case of reduced earning capacity (Grundsicherung im Alter und bei Erwerbsminderung)
grundsicherung-im-alter-und-bei-erwerbsm.erklaerung: A social assistance benefit for people who, among other things because of age or permanent full reduction in earning capacity, cannot sufficiently secure their necessary living costs from their own means and meet the legal requirements.

haeusliche-pflege.erklaerung: Care and support provided in the home environment. Depending on the care level and situation, different long-term care insurance benefits may apply.

hilfe-in-anderen-lebenslagen.begriff: Help in other circumstances (Hilfe in anderen Lebenslagen)
hilfe-in-anderen-lebenslagen.erklaerung: A group of social assistance benefits for special life situations. Which help is possible depends on the relevant legal provision.

hilfe-zur-pflege.erklaerung: A social assistance benefit for people in need of care, if the legal requirements are met and necessary care cannot be sufficiently covered by other benefits or own means.

hilfe-zur-ueberwindung-besonderer-sozial.begriff: Help to overcome particular social difficulties (Hilfe zur Überwindung besonderer sozialer Schwierigkeiten)
hilfe-zur-ueberwindung-besonderer-sozial.erklaerung: A social assistance benefit for people whose particular living conditions are combined with social difficulties that they cannot overcome on their own.

hilfe-zum-lebensunterhalt.begriff: Help with living costs (Hilfe zum Lebensunterhalt)
hilfe-zum-lebensunterhalt.erklaerung: A social assistance benefit for people who cannot sufficiently cover their necessary living costs from their own means or from benefits with priority, and who meet the legal requirements.

hilfen-zur-gesundheit.erklaerung: Social assistance benefits for health care in certain cases, if the legal requirements are met.

hilfesystem.erklaerung: This does not mean a single law. The term describes how different bodies and benefit systems work together, for example health insurance, long-term care insurance, social assistance, integration assistance, rehabilitation, youth welfare and social compensation.

hilfsmittel.erklaerung: Objects or technical aids that can compensate for health limitations, support treatment or enable participation. Which benefit provider is responsible depends on the need and the legal basis.

individueller-bedarf.erklaerung: Benefits should be based on the personal situation and the support actually needed, not on a diagnosis alone.

inklusion.erklaerung: Inclusion describes the goal that people with and without disabilities can take part in social life equally and with as few barriers as possible.

krankenbehandlung.erklaerung: Benefits for medical care. Which benefits are covered and which provider is responsible depends on the benefit system concerned.

krankenkasse.erklaerung: Provider of statutory health insurance. Among other things, it is responsible for medical treatment benefits provided for by law and certain rehabilitation benefits.

kurzzeitpflege.erklaerung: Temporary full inpatient care when home care is temporarily not, or not yet, sufficiently possible and the legal requirements are met.

leistungsberechtigte-person.erklaerung: A person who meets the legal requirements for a particular social benefit.

leistungserbringer.erklaerung: A person, facility or service that actually delivers an approved benefit, for example a care service or assistance service. Service providers and benefit providers are not the same.

leistungsgruppe.erklaerung: SGB IX distinguishes different groups of participation benefits, for example medical rehabilitation, participation in working life, participation in education and social participation.

leistungstraeger.erklaerung: Public bodies, institutions or authorities responsible for certain social benefits. Which body is responsible follows from the relevant benefit law.

leistungen-bei-pflegebeduerftigkeit.begriff: Benefits for people in need of care (Leistungen bei Pflegebedürftigkeit)
leistungen-bei-pflegebeduerftigkeit.erklaerung: Depending on the benefit system and individual requirements, benefits can be provided if there is a need for long-term care.

leistungen-der-sozialen-entschaedigung.begriff: Social compensation benefits (Leistungen der Sozialen Entschädigung)
leistungen-der-sozialen-entschaedigung.erklaerung: SGB XIV provides for different areas of benefits, including fast help, medical treatment, participation, benefits for people in need of care and compensation payments.

leistungen-zur-medizinischen-rehabilitat.begriff: Medical rehabilitation benefits (Leistungen zur medizinischen Rehabilitation)
leistungen-zur-medizinischen-rehabilitat.erklaerung: Benefits meant to prevent, reduce or compensate for health impairments or prevent them from getting worse, and to support participation.

leistungen-zur-sozialen-teilhabe.begriff: Social participation benefits (Leistungen zur Sozialen Teilhabe)
leistungen-zur-sozialen-teilhabe.erklaerung: Benefits meant to enable or make easier a self-determined and equal participation in community life.

leistungen-zur-teilhabe.erklaerung: Benefits meant to promote rehabilitation, self-determination and participation. Which benefits are possible depends on individual need and the responsible rehabilitation provider.

leistungen-zur-teilhabe-am-arbeitsleben.begriff: Benefits for participation in working life (Leistungen zur Teilhabe am Arbeitsleben)
leistungen-zur-teilhabe-am-arbeitsleben.erklaerung: Benefits meant to help a person take up, carry out or keep a job.

leistungen-zur-teilhabe-an-bildung.begriff: Benefits for participation in education (Leistungen zur Teilhabe an Bildung)
leistungen-zur-teilhabe-an-bildung.erklaerung: Benefits that, under the legal requirements, can enable or support equal participation in education.

medizinischer-dienst-md.erklaerung: In cases provided for by law, the Medical Service supports the statutory health and long-term care insurance funds with medical and nursing assessments or statements. The decision on the benefit is generally made by the responsible benefit provider.

mehrbedarf.erklaerung: In certain social benefit systems, an additional need regulated by law can be taken into account on top of the regular need.

merkzeichen.erklaerung: Certain marks can be entered in a severely disabled person's pass if the relevant legal requirements are met. They can come with certain compensations for disadvantages.

nachrang-nachrangigkeit.erklaerung: Some social benefits generally only come into question if no benefit with priority from another provider applies. Which rule applies depends on the benefit system concerned.

nachteilsausgleich.erklaerung: Benefits or relief provided for by law can compensate for certain disadvantages caused by a disability. Which compensations apply depends on the relevant requirements.

persoenliches-budget-sozialrecht.erklaerung: On application, certain participation benefits can be provided as a personal budget. The aim is to give people entitled to benefits more responsibility and the most self-determined way possible of organising their support. The personal budget is not an additional benefit but a form of providing benefits.

pflegeberatung.erklaerung: People who are entitled can receive individual advice and support in choosing and using care benefits and other help.

pflegebeduerftigkeit.erklaerung: In terms of long-term care insurance, people are in need of care if health-related impairments limit their independence or abilities, they therefore need help, and this need is likely to last at least six months.

pflegebegutachtung.erklaerung: An assessment checks whether there is a need for care in terms of long-term care insurance and which care level, if any, can be determined.

pflegegeld.erklaerung: A cash benefit that can be paid for home care under the legal requirements.

pflegegrad-sozialrecht.erklaerung: The care level describes how severely independence or abilities are impaired. Long-term care insurance distinguishes five care levels.

pflegehilfsmittel.erklaerung: Aids that can make care easier, relieve complaints or enable a more independent life.

pflegekasse.erklaerung: Provider of the social long-term care insurance. The long-term care insurance fund is set up at the respective statutory health insurance fund.

pflegeperson.erklaerung: In terms of long-term care insurance, a carer is a person who cares for someone in need of care in their home, not as a job. Additional requirements apply for some social insurance entitlements.

pflegesachleistung.erklaerung: A benefit where approved professional care or support services provide the services and bill the long-term care insurance fund.

pflegestuetzpunkt.erklaerung: A local advice centre that, where such structures exist, can bundle information and support on care and other help.

rehabilitation.erklaerung: Benefits and measures meant to prevent, reduce or compensate for health limitations and to enable or maintain participation.

rehabilitationsbedarf.erklaerung: This describes whether rehabilitation benefits may be needed, and which.

rehabilitationstraeger.erklaerung: The bodies named in SGB IX that can be responsible for rehabilitation and participation depending on the type of benefit, for example health insurance funds, pension insurance, accident insurance, the Federal Employment Agency, integration assistance or social compensation providers.

sachleistung.erklaerung: A social benefit where no money is paid out; instead a specific service or care is provided.

schwerbehindert.erklaerung: Under SGB IX, people are severely disabled if a GdB of at least 50 has been determined and the legal requirements are met.

schwerbehindertenausweis.erklaerung: A pass that proves the status of a severely disabled person and, where applicable, certain marks.

selbstbestimmung.erklaerung: An important aim of rehabilitation and participation law is to give people as much room as possible for their own decisions and for shaping their lives on their own responsibility.

schnelle-hilfen.erklaerung: Under social compensation law this includes case management and help in a trauma outpatient clinic.

soziale-entschaedigung.erklaerung: Social compensation law supports people who have suffered damage to their health from certain harmful events covered by law in dealing with the consequences.

soziale-teilhabe.erklaerung: This means equal participation in community life. Social participation benefits can enable it or make it easier.

sozialhilfe.erklaerung: Social assistance under SGB XII includes various kinds of help for people who meet the relevant legal requirements, for example help with living costs, basic income support, health assistance and help with care.

sozialleistung.erklaerung: A service, benefit in kind or cash benefit provided for in the Social Code. Personal and educational help can also be services.

tagespflege-und-nachtpflege.begriff: Day care and night care (Tagespflege und Nachtpflege)
tagespflege-und-nachtpflege.erklaerung: Forms of partial inpatient care. People in need of care are looked after in a facility for part of the day or night and otherwise continue to live at home.

teilhabe.erklaerung: Participation means being able to take part in different areas of social life as self-determined and as equally as possible.

teilhabe-am-arbeitsleben.begriff: Participation in working life (Teilhabe am Arbeitsleben)
teilhabe-am-arbeitsleben.erklaerung: This means taking part in working life. Benefits can help to enable, keep or restore employment.

teilhabe-an-bildung.erklaerung: This means equal participation in education. Benefits may be needed so that people with disabilities can take part.

teilhabeplan.erklaerung: If several benefit groups or rehabilitation providers are involved, the necessary benefits are coordinated and documented in a participation plan under certain conditions.

teilhabeplankonferenz.erklaerung: With the consent of the person entitled to benefits, the bodies involved can discuss the rehabilitation need and the necessary benefits together.

teilhabeplanverfahren.erklaerung: A procedure in which several necessary rehabilitation or participation benefits are coordinated with one another.

teilhabezielvereinbarung.erklaerung: In integration assistance, the provider can conclude an agreement with the person entitled to benefits on the goals of the overall plan or parts of it.

traumaambulanz.erklaerung: Under social compensation law, eligible persons can, under the legal requirements, receive psychotherapeutic intervention in a trauma outpatient clinic contracted for this purpose.

traeger-der-eingliederungshilfe.erklaerung: The body responsible under state law for integration assistance benefits.

traeger-der-sozialen-entschaedigung.begriff: Social compensation provider (Träger der Sozialen Entschädigung)
traeger-der-sozialen-entschaedigung.erklaerung: The body responsible under state law for benefits under SGB XIV.

verhinderungspflege.erklaerung: A care benefit for certain situations in which the private carer is temporarily unable to care. Requirements and scope depend on the long-term care insurance law in force.

vollstationaere-pflege.erklaerung: Care and support in a full inpatient care facility. Which benefits long-term care insurance covers depends among other things on the care level and the legal requirements.

vorrangige-leistung.erklaerung: A benefit that, because of legal responsibilities, comes into question before another benefit.

wohnumfeldverbessernde-massnahmen.begriff: Measures to improve the living environment (Wohnumfeldverbessernde Maßnahmen)
wohnumfeldverbessernde-massnahmen.erklaerung: Under certain conditions, grants can be made for measures that change the home so that care becomes easier or a more independent life becomes possible.

wunsch-und-wahlrecht.begriff: Right to wishes and choice (Wunsch- und Wahlrecht)
wunsch-und-wahlrecht.erklaerung: For participation benefits, justified wishes of the person entitled to benefits should be taken into account. Personal circumstances and individual need play a role, among other things. Not every wish has to be fulfilled automatically.

zielvereinbarung-beim-persoenlichen-budg.begriff: Goal agreement for the personal budget (Zielvereinbarung beim Persönlichen Budget)
zielvereinbarung-beim-persoenlichen-budg.erklaerung: In connection with the personal budget, the person entitled to benefits and the responsible benefit provider make agreements on how the budget is carried out.

zustaendigkeit-sozialrecht.erklaerung: This means which benefit provider or authority is responsible for a particular benefit or procedure.

zustaendigkeitsklaerung.erklaerung: For rehabilitation and participation benefits, once an application has been received it must be clarified which rehabilitation provider is responsible for processing it.

aktenlage.erklaerung: An assessment is made on the basis of the existing documents. Whether a personal examination is also needed depends on the assignment and the procedure.

aktenstudium.erklaerung: Existing medical and other documents relevant to the question are read and evaluated.

aktivitaeten.erklaerung: This means actions and tasks a person carries out in everyday life. Social medicine assessments can look at whether and by what these activities are limited.

aktivitaeten-des-taeglichen-lebens.begriff: Activities of daily living (Aktivitäten des täglichen Lebens)
aktivitaeten-des-taeglichen-lebens.erklaerung: These include everyday activities such as personal hygiene, dressing, eating, getting around or other tasks of daily self-care. Which areas are looked at depends on the procedure.

allgemeinzustand.erklaerung: This describes a person's overall physical impression. The exact meaning follows from the medical context.

anamnese.erklaerung: This is the history of an illness. It can include current complaints, previous illnesses, treatments, medication and psychological and social factors. Patient records regularly contain information on the medical history.

arbeitsanamnese-berufsanamnese.erklaerung: Information on previous work, the workplace and the actual physical or psychological demands of the job.

arbeitsfaehigkeit.erklaerung: This assesses whether a person can currently do their specific job despite an illness. Fitness for work is not the same as earning capacity or reduced earning capacity.

arbeitsunfaehigkeit.erklaerung: Because of an illness, a person currently cannot do their most recent job, or only at the risk of getting worse. Incapacity for work does not automatically mean that no gainful work will ever be possible again.

arztbrief.erklaerung: A doctor's letter summarises important information about treatment, for example medical history, diagnoses, findings, treatments, medication and recommendations.

attest.erklaerung: A doctor's certificate on a particular medical fact or question. A certificate is usually shorter and less comprehensive than a findings report or an expert opinion.

ausschlussdiagnose.erklaerung: A possible illness is specifically examined to establish whether it can be ruled out as the cause of the complaints.

begleiterkrankung.erklaerung: A further illness or health disorder that exists in addition to another illness.

begutachtung.erklaerung: An expert examines and evaluates medical or social medicine questions for a particular assignment. The scope depends on the specific question.

begutachtungsauftrag.erklaerung: This sets out which medical or social medicine questions an expert opinion is to answer.

behandlungsbeduerftigkeit.erklaerung: This describes whether treatment is necessary from a medical point of view. Which treatment makes sense depends on the specific illness and situation.

behandlungsdokumentation.erklaerung: The records of diagnoses, findings, examinations, therapies, medication and the course of treatment. Such information is regularly part of the patient record.

behandlungsverlauf.erklaerung: This describes how complaints, illness and treatment have developed over a certain period.

befund.erklaerung: A finding describes a result of a medical examination or observation, for example a physical examination, imaging, laboratory test or mental status examination.

befundbericht.erklaerung: A medical report summarising the findings and other relevant information.

befundmitteilung.erklaerung: A short notice about the result of an examination.

befundtatsache.erklaerung: A medical fact established during an examination or from documents.

belastbarkeit.erklaerung: This describes which physical or psychological demands a person can cope with.

beurteilung.erklaerung: Here the available information, complaints and findings are placed in a medical or social medicine context.

dauerdiagnose.erklaerung: A diagnosis that is recorded as relevant over a longer period. This alone does not show how severe the illness currently is.

diagnose.erklaerung: The medical determination of an illness or health disorder based on the information and findings gathered.

differentialdiagnose.erklaerung: Different illnesses or causes that could fit the complaints or findings are examined.

eigenangaben.erklaerung: Information that the examined person gives about their complaints, limitations and life situation.

eigenanamnese.erklaerung: Information a person gives about their own medical history, complaints and treatments.

einschraenkung.erklaerung: This describes that a physical, psychological or mental ability is not present or only to a limited extent.

empfehlung.erklaerung: A professional assessment of which further examination, treatment, rehabilitation or support might make sense. A medical recommendation is not automatically a legal decision on benefits.

entlassungsbericht-entlassbrief.erklaerung: A report after inpatient treatment or rehabilitation. It can record diagnoses, findings, treatments, course, medication and recommendations. Doctor's letters typically contain such information.

epikrise-epikritische-beurteilung.erklaerung: A summarising medical evaluation of the course of illness and treatment and of the findings.

erwerbsfaehigkeit-medizin.erklaerung: A social law term referring to the extent to which a person can still do gainful work under the relevant legal requirements.

erwerbsminderung-medizin.erklaerung: A legal term used mainly in the statutory pension insurance. Whether there is reduced earning capacity in the legal sense is decided by the responsible pension insurance provider on the basis of the legal requirements and the medical assessment.

faehigkeitsstoerung-faehigkeitsbeeintrae.erklaerung: A limitation in certain abilities or actions, for example concentration, mobility or resilience.

fachaerztliche-stellungnahme.erklaerung: A medical assessment by a specialist doctor on a particular question.

finalitaetsgutachten.erklaerung: A final perspective focuses mainly on the current state of health and its effects. Whether this term is used in a specific procedure depends on the area of assessment.

fremdanamnese.erklaerung: Information on the medical history or situation that comes from sources other than the examined person, for example relatives or documents.

fremdbefund.erklaerung: A finding made by another treating or examining body.

funktionsbeeintraechtigung.erklaerung: A limitation of physical, psychological or mental functions.

funktionsbefund.erklaerung: A description of specific functional abilities or limitations.

funktionsfaehigkeit.erklaerung: Describes which physical, psychological or mental functions and activities are possible for a person.

gesundheitsstoerung.erklaerung: An umbrella term for an impairment of physical or mental health.

gutachten.erklaerung: A professional assessment of a specific question. It regularly contains an evaluation of the available information and findings and a comprehensible medical or social medicine assessment.

gutachter-gutachterin.erklaerung: An expert who has been commissioned with a medical or social medicine assessment.

gutachtliche-stellungnahme.erklaerung: A professional assessment of a specific question. Scope and content depend on the assignment.

gutachtenauftrag.erklaerung: The question the expert assessor is to answer. The specific assignment is decisive for the content of an expert opinion.

icd-code.erklaerung: A coded label for diagnoses under the International Classification of Diseases. The code alone does not automatically say how severe an illness is in the individual case.

indikation.erklaerung: The medical reason for carrying out a particular examination, treatment or measure.

kausalitaet-kausalzusammenhang.erklaerung: This examines whether there is a causal connection between an event or cause and a health disorder. What is required of this connection depends on the procedure.

kausalitaetsgutachten.erklaerung: An expert opinion that examines in particular whether a certain event or influence caused a health damage or its consequences.

klinischer-befund.erklaerung: Results found during a medical examination.

komorbiditaet.erklaerung: One or more illnesses that exist in addition to another illness.

konsistenz.erklaerung: An assessment can examine whether statements, observations and findings appear compatible with one another. A single anomaly does not on its own allow a final evaluation.

kontextfaktoren.erklaerung: Personal and environmental factors that can influence how an illness or disability affects everyday life and participation. Such factors are taken into account in social medicine assessments.

leistungsbeurteilung.erklaerung: A medical or social medicine assessment of which activities and demands are possible for a person from a health point of view.

leistungsbild.erklaerung: A summarising description of the existing capacity and the health-related limitations.

leistungsfaehigkeit.erklaerung: Describes which physical or psychological demands a person can cope with from a medical point of view. The social medicine assessment of the German Pension Insurance explicitly considers capacity in working life.

leistungsvermoegen.erklaerung: Describes which activities a person can still carry out from a health point of view, and under what conditions.

qualitatives-leistungsvermoegen.erklaerung: Describes which kinds of activities, demands and working conditions are still possible or limited from a health point of view. Rehabilitation reports explicitly assess qualitative capacity.

quantitatives-leistungsvermoegen.erklaerung: Describes the amount of time for which an activity can be carried out from a social medicine point of view. In the pension insurance this is assessed, among other things, for the most recent job and the general labour market.

positives-leistungsbild-positives-leistu.begriff: Positive capacity profile (Positives Leistungsbild / positives Leistungsvermögen)
positives-leistungsbild-positives-leistu.erklaerung: Describes which activities and demands are still possible from a health point of view.

negatives-leistungsbild-leistungseinschr.begriff: Negative capacity profile / limitations (Negatives Leistungsbild / Leistungseinschränkungen)
negatives-leistungsbild-leistungseinschr.erklaerung: Describes activities, demands or working conditions that are not possible, or only to a limited extent, from a health point of view.

medikation.erklaerung: The medicines that have been prescribed or are being taken.

medizinischer-dienst-md-medizin.erklaerung: In cases provided for by law, the Medical Service supports the statutory health and long-term care insurance funds with medical and social medicine assessments and statements.

mitbehandlung.erklaerung: Another doctor or other professional is also involved in the treatment.

nachuntersuchung.erklaerung: A further examination at a later date to assess further development.

nebenbefund.erklaerung: An additional finding made during an examination that was not necessarily the original reason for it.

objektivierbarer-befund.erklaerung: A finding that can be established or documented in a comprehensible way using medical examination methods. If complaints cannot be objectified, this does not automatically mean that they do not exist.

operationsbericht.erklaerung: Documentation of a surgical procedure. Surgical reports are among the information that can be part of a patient record.

patientenakte.erklaerung: Essential information on treatment is documented here, for example medical history, diagnoses, examinations, findings, therapies, medication, doctor's letters and, where applicable, surgical reports.

pathologisch.erklaerung: Medical term for a finding that is diseased or deviates from the medical norm. What the deviation means must be assessed in context.

plausibilitaet.erklaerung: This assesses whether statements, findings and medical connections appear comprehensible.

primaerschaden.erklaerung: In causality assessments, this can refer to damage to health caused directly by a particular event or influence. The exact use depends on the area of law.

prognose.erklaerung: A professional assessment of how an illness, functional impairment or capacity is likely to develop. It is an estimate, not a certain prediction.

psychischer-befund-psychopathologischer-.begriff: Mental status / psychopathological findings (Psychischer Befund / psychopathologischer Befund)
psychischer-befund-psychopathologischer-.erklaerung: A structured description of the current mental state, for example with regard to mood, thinking, perception, orientation and drive.

rehabilitationsbedarf-medizin.erklaerung: This examines whether rehabilitation benefits may be necessary.

rehabilitationsbeduerftigkeit.erklaerung: The social medicine assessment examines whether, because of health impairments, a rehabilitation benefit is necessary to maintain or improve participation or capacity. It is a separate criterion.

rehabilitationsfaehigkeit.erklaerung: This assesses whether physical and psychological resilience allow active participation in a suitable rehabilitation measure.

rehabilitationsprognose.erklaerung: A medically founded assessment of whether the goals of the rehabilitation are likely to be achieved.

rehabilitationspotential.erklaerung: This can describe existing possibilities and resources that can be used or improved through rehabilitation. The term is used in connection with the rehabilitation prognosis.

rehabilitationsziel.erklaerung: The goal a rehabilitation measure is meant to achieve, for example improved participation or working capacity.

remission.erklaerung: Signs of illness or complaints have clearly decreased or are temporarily no longer present. Remission does not automatically mean a permanent cure.

reservekapazitaet.erklaerung: A social medicine term that can describe whether there are still health or functional possibilities that can be used through treatment or rehabilitation.

schaedigung.erklaerung: In social medicine contexts, this can refer to impairments of body functions or body structures.

sekundaerschaden-folgeschaden.erklaerung: Damage to health that may have developed as a result of other damage to health or an event. Whether such a connection actually exists must be examined in the procedure.

somatischer-befund.erklaerung: A finding relating to the state of physical health.

sozialanamnese.erklaerung: Information on living circumstances, work, housing, family, support and other social factors, insofar as they are relevant to the medical or social medicine assessment.

sozialmedizinische-begutachtung.erklaerung: An assessment in which health impairments are evaluated in connection with capacity, rehabilitation, participation or social law questions. The German Pension Insurance describes the assessment of capacity and need for rehabilitation, among other things, as central tasks.

sozialmedizinische-leistungsbeurteilung.begriff: Social medicine assessment of capacity (Sozialmedizinische Leistungsbeurteilung)
sozialmedizinische-leistungsbeurteilung.erklaerung: A summarising professional assessment of which activities and demands are still possible for a person, taking their health limitations into account.

sozialmedizinische-stellungnahme.erklaerung: A professional social medicine assessment of a particular question. In pension insurance assessments, a final social medicine statement is part of the process.

stellungnahme-medizin.erklaerung: A professional assessment of a particular medical or social medicine question.

subjektive-angaben-subjektive-beschwerde.begriff: Subjective statements / subjective complaints (Subjektive Angaben / subjektive Beschwerden)
subjektive-angaben-subjektive-beschwerde.erklaerung: Complaints or limitations that a person describes themselves. These statements are part of the medical assessment and can be considered together with other findings.

teilhabe-medizin.erklaerung: This means a person being involved in different areas of life, for example work, social relationships or social life.

teilhabebeeintraechtigung.erklaerung: A health-related limitation of participation in one or more areas of life.

therapieansprechen.erklaerung: This describes whether and how a treatment has had an effect.

therapieempfehlung.erklaerung: A professional recommendation on which further treatment or medical measure might make sense.

therapieerfolg.erklaerung: This describes which changes a treatment has achieved.

therapieverlauf.erklaerung: Description of the treatment carried out and of how complaints and findings developed during that time.

untersuchungsbefund.erklaerung: The result of a medical examination.

untersuchungsergebnis.erklaerung: The results found during an examination.

vegetative-anamnese.erklaerung: Information on, for example, sleep, appetite, weight, excretion or other basic bodily functions. Such information can be part of a detailed assessment.

verdachtsdiagnose.erklaerung: An illness is suspected on the basis of the information so far but has not yet been finally confirmed.

verlauf.erklaerung: This describes how complaints, illness, findings or treatment have developed over time.

verlaufskontrolle.erklaerung: A later examination or assessment that checks for changes in the course of illness or treatment.

vorerkrankung.erklaerung: An illness that already existed before the event or period currently being considered.

vorbefund.erklaerung: A finding made earlier that can be taken into account in the current assessment or compared with new findings.

vorgutachten.erklaerung: An expert opinion prepared earlier that can be taken into account as a document in a later assessment.

wechselwirkung.erklaerung: Different illnesses, complaints, medicines or other factors influence one another.

zusatzbefund.erklaerung: An additional medical finding made during an examination or supplementary diagnostics.

zusatzdiagnostik.erklaerung: Additional examinations that may be necessary to answer a medical or assessment question. The German Pension Insurance explicitly takes necessary supplementary diagnostics into account in the assessment process.

zusammenfassende-beurteilung.erklaerung: At the end of a report or expert opinion, the most important findings, connections and professional assessments are brought together.

zustand-nach-z-n.erklaerung: Means that a certain event, illness or treatment took place in the past, for example „Zustand nach Operation“ (status after surgery).

narkoseprotokoll.erklaerung: Documentation of anaesthesia in connection with a procedure. Anaesthesia records can be part of the patient record.
